settings.title: Everything You Need to Know About us.

items.item_title: Do you train supervisors or team leaders?
Who can join the training program?
What skills are taught in training?
How long is the training period?

settings.editor: Yes, we have specialized leadership and management training for cleaning supervisors.
Anyone interested in working in the cleaning industry, regardless of experience, can apply for training.
We cover cleaning techniques, safety practices, customer service, and equipment handling.
Training typically lasts one to two weeks, depending on the course and skill level.

items.item_title: Do trainees receive certificates after training?
Can Soclean help me find a job?
Do you offer on-site training for companies?
How can I apply to join Soclean?

settings.editor: Yes, participants receive a certification upon completing the program and passing the evaluation.
Yes, we connect trained cleaners with trusted employers in residential, office, and commercial sectors.
Yes, we provide customized training for cleaning teams at company facilities.
You can apply through our website or visit our training center to register in person.
